title: nimblescape Markdown Comment Links
description: Clickable Markdown links in code comments that open at the named heading.

title: RodiumAi Code
description: RodiumAi Code, the coding agent for VS Code and Cursor: the full RodiumAi Code Desktop experience in an editor tab.

title: Auto Push Tags
description: Asks whether to push a Git tag to the remote right after you create it.

title: Punarnava — Old Java to Modern Java (Learn Java 25)
description: Turn old Java (public static void main, Scanner, colon switch) into modern Java 25 — side-by-side, with a Hinglish/English explanation and a quiz for every change. Output verified to compile and behave the same.

title: Velvet Pro
description: A refined, warm-dark theme featuring deep charcoal tones and subtle crimson accents, optimized for long, comfortable coding sessions.

title: Proxmox Migration Check: VMware vSphere Lint
description: Maps every VMware vSphere dependency in Terraform, Packer and Ansible files (vsphere provider, vsphere-iso builder, community.vmware tasks) to the exact Proxmox VE replacement line.

title: Grundsteuer Fristen-Check für Objektlisten
description: Prüft Objekt-Änderungslisten (CSV) auf Grundsteuer-Anzeigefristen: § 228 BewG (31. März des Folgejahres), Wertfortschreibung über 15.000 € (§ 222 BewG), Landesmodelle, Eigentümerwechsel.

title: GNU GLOBAL (gtags) Workspace Setup Kit
description: 46 config snippets, 26 audit rules, 8 setups in one extension — because one absolute path like /home/you/ in .vscode/settings.json breaks Go-to-Definition for every teammate who clones the repo.

title: 派遣契約書チェック — 個別契約・就業条件明示書
description: 労働者派遣の個別契約書と就業条件明示書の下書き(.md/.txt)を、派遣法26条1項・施行規則22条・34条の記載事項と照らし、抜けている項目を行番号つきで示します。派遣元の営業・法務担当向け。

title: Notes for VS Code
description: Browse dated notes Markdown files in a movable Explorer section.

title: devin-doctor
description: Ecosystem health checks from devin-doctor, inside the editor. Thin adapter: the extension shells out to the devin-doctor CLI and renders the result — no check logic is reimplemented here.

title: PyDebugScope
description: Visualize numpy / torch / jax / tensorflow arrays as signals, images and histograms, and explore pandas / polars DataFrames with filter, search, sort, copy and column plots while debugging Python.

title: C Insight
description: Source Insight-style C/C++ navigation powered by clangd or Microsoft C/C++.
